response.description: Ultra Disk support is now available in public preview for Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server. You can use Azure’s highest-performance managed disk option for I/O-intensive and transaction-heavy PostgreSQL workloads that require consistently low sub-millisecond latency, high IOPS, and throughput. With independently configurable capacity and performance, you can align storage needs more closely with your workload requirements.   Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Ultra Disk
